title: Spyglass is Officially Here!
summary: The highly anticipated Spyglass tool is now officially launched, empowering you with advanced insights and a seamless experience.

title: Rich Media & File Control
summary: Effortlessly manage and customize all your images and files within the editor with our new intuitive control panel, designed to enhance your content creation.

title: Transparency Unveiled: Your Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new public roadmap, giving you full visibility into what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's planned for the future.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: We've significantly enhanced our checkboxes, making them bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable to streamline your tasks and improve overall usability.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: Experience a new level of teamwork with our enhanced editor, designed to make collaborating with others effortless and clear.

title: Effortless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've made it easier to discover and collaborate on shared content with your friends and team, making teamwork more intuitive and connected.

title: Noeko Now Speaks Your Language
summary: Noeko is now more accessible than ever with exciting new support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and direct involvement in shaping the project's exciting future.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Constellation
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by dynamically filtering your graph view by tags, time, and shared items, transforming it into a powerful workflow starter.

title: Precision Search & Custom Compendiums
summary: Unlock a new level of knowledge organization with enhanced search filters, empowering you to swiftly narrow down information and save personalized views for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts and interact with related information through dynamic new display options for linked content, making your notes more visually engaging and functional.

title: Introducing Noeko: Self-Hosted and Cloud Options
summary: We are excited to officially launch Noeko, empowering teams with the flexibility to deploy it on their own servers or utilize our managed cloud service with tailored subscription plans.

title: Enhanced Themes and Exciting New Customization Options
summary: We're enhancing our current themes and introducing a diverse collection of new, vibrant options to refresh your workspace.

title: Smarter Welcome Messages
summary: Enjoy a perfectly timed welcome on your homepage, as we refine our greetings to accurately reflect the time of day wherever you are.

title: Quick Actions in Tag Views
summary: Quickly remove items from tags or delete them directly from list views, empowering you with faster and more flexible content management.

title: Universal Content Support
summary: Get ready to seamlessly integrate a much wider range of information, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, directly into your knowledge base with new dedicated viewing experiences.
